milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to navigate near the target object and face it, confirming visual identification. The rose bush is placed at spawn-relative coordinates (8, 0, 10), approximately 12.8 blocks from spawn. The player must get within 5 blocks and face toward it (within 60 degrees) to demonstrate they have found and are looking at the rose bush.
